title: K’UHUL Runtime Explorer
definition: A typed semantic runtime and language stack that organizes keys and fields into bounded Micronaut programs.

phase_sequence.label: Ingress
phase_sequence.description: Receive input, establish identity and provenance.

phase_sequence.label: Bind context
phase_sequence.description: Resolve definitions, context, and typed assignments.

phase_sequence.label: Expand candidates
phase_sequence.description: Generate possible keys, questions, and routes.

phase_sequence.label: Propose or dispatch
phase_sequence.description: Select work; dispatch remains subject to admission.

phase_sequence.label: Close
phase_sequence.description: Close an admitted fold and record its result.

note: Diagram explains repository concepts; it does not authorize execution. Sek proposes, Ch'en verifies, and Xul closes only admitted work.
